blocks.title: Overview
blocks.text: Amphenol provides high-technology interconnect, sensor, antenna and cable solutions across a broad range of end markets.

evidence.quote: Amphenol is one of the world’s largest providers of high-technology interconnect, sensor, antenna and cable solutions.

blocks.title: Business approach
blocks.text: The company describes expanding its high-technology product offering organically and through acquisitions.

evidence.quote: expanding our high-technology product offering both organically and through our successful acquisition program

cells: Connector and interconnect systems, cable and antennas; used in IT and data communications, mobile devices, industrial, communications networks, automotive, commercial aerospace and defense.

evidence.quote: designs, manufactures and markets a broad range of connector and interconnect systems, including high speed, radio frequency, power, fiber optic and other interconnect products; coaxial, fiber optic and high-speed cable; antennas

cells: Ruggedized interconnect products, specialty cable, printed circuits and printed circuit assemblies; used in industrial, defense, commercial aerospace, automotive, communications networks and IT and data communications.

evidence.quote: designs, manufactures and markets a broad range of ruggedized interconnect products, including connectors and interconnect systems, specialty cable, printed circuits and printed circuit assemblies

cells: Sensors, sensor-based systems, connectors and value-add interconnect systems; used in automotive, industrial, IT and data communications, communications networks, defense and commercial aerospace.

evidence.quote: designs, manufactures and markets a broad range of sensors, sensor-based systems, connectors and value-add interconnect systems
